audience: developers and operations teams who generate PDFs and images from CraftMyPDF templates

useCases.title: List your templates and the data each one expects
useCases.text: The AI lists your templates and opens one to show the sample JSON data it expects, so you know which placeholders to fill in.

useCases.title: Check your quota and recent generations
useCases.text: The AI reads the quota used and the quota total, and lists recent generation transactions with type, credits used and result status.

useCases.title: Review template usage and saved versions
useCases.text: The AI reads usage statistics of up to 20 templates in a date range and lists the saved versions of a template, so you can pin a version.

useCases.title: Read the metadata of a PDF at a public URL
useCases.text: The AI reads page count, title, author, creator, producer and dates of a PDF that CraftMyPDF downloads from a public https URL.

useCases.title: Generate a PDF or image from a template
useCases.text: The AI fills a template with your JSON data and returns a hosted file URL for a PDF or an image. It uses your account credits.

useCases.title: Combine several templates or PDFs into one PDF
useCases.text: The AI renders 2 to 10 templates into one PDF, or merges 2 to 10 existing PDFs given by public URL. It uses your account credits.
